svg.title: Known-best packing of 264 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=264 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete rational corners Witness/v2 for 264 unit squares, promoted from a decimal pose. Certifies finite feasibility and an upper bound at its exact side.

svg.text: U n=264 known best: side ~ 16.77216831 (certified upper bound)
